activity_summary: Between the rehearsal and the play you were at the lodging. You put two houses and a street on the tables, and the serving-men, and no words for them. Brooke stayed on the shelf. You did not write a line of the play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote three lines on the tables and did not open the poem.

facets.activity: Put two houses, a street, and the serving-men on the tables
